strictTyping: Dynamic objects must have a dummy property (e.g. _dummy: { type: 'string' }).
No $schema, $ref, patternProperties, or complex anyOf allowed.
zeroDefectProtocol.preBuildValidation: npm run build and unit tests must pass before ending a phase.

general: Output messages must be in Thai (Technical English allowed).
Logging must use console.error to avoid corrupting Stdio MCP protocol.
